title: Replace per-query grep process with an in-process indexed matcher
weakness: Each search call spawns grep, so process startup dominates warm latency on a small fixed corpus.
hypothesis: Scanning the corpus once into a cache and matching lines in-process will cut warm median batch latency to at most 0.75x the grep baseline while preserving every result.
metric: Warm median batch latency, cold batch latency, and hash equality on 20 frozen queries.
change: Promote experiments/E001-search-index/search_candidate.py to tools/search.py; keep grep as the fallback for patterns where Python and GNU ERE differ.
risk: Python regex semantics differ from GNU grep ERE; the fallback must catch unsafe patterns and equivalence must be proven on frozen hashes.
